names.ja: シェフレラ・アルボリコラ

light.min.quote: Deep shade (Less than 2 hours to no direct sunlight)

light.directSun.quote: as a houseplant, bright, direct light will burn the leaves

temperature.idealC.quote: Scheffleras prefer day temperatures between 65 and 75 °F.

watering.growing.quote: Water scheffleras thoroughly, then let the soil dry to ½ inch deep before watering again.

watering.winter.reason: 出典に冬の記載がないため、室温が下がると水を吸う量が減ることから一段乾かし気味とした

tips.ja: 土が湿りすぎても乾きすぎても葉を落とす。
tips.quote: If the soil is too wet or too dry the leave will drop off.

tips.ja: 光不足で葉が黄色くなり、茎がひょろひょろになる。
tips.quote: Low light can cause leaf yellowing with spindly, weak stems.

tips.ja: 水のやりすぎ・湿度不足・寒さで葉が落ちる。
tips.quote: Leaf drop can be caused by excessive watering, by low humidity, or by chilling.

note: 以前の学名は Schefflera arboricola。
